text: Shortcut Extensions（DSH 插件，网页界面）：为 DSH 增加可开关、可改键的快捷操作，并在侧边栏提供管理面板。它通过宿主快捷键注册表接入命令，并把模型、会话和技能选择器作为界面浮层呈现。用户可搜索并切换模型、查找或切换会话、浏览已安装技能并将技能命令插入输入框，也可跳到已回答会话、聚焦输入框或循环切换权限。适合希望用键盘快速操作 DSH 的用户。代码未声明 API 密钥或外部服务配置；插件依赖 DSH 提供的界面服务。

Shortcut Extensions adds configurable keyboard shortcuts and a sidebar panel to DSH web. Search and switch models, browse and open sessions, insert skill commands at the composer caret, jump to answered sessions, focus the composer, or cycle permission presets. No API keys are declared.
想用快捷键快速搜索并切换 DSH 当前会话的模型。
有没有办法从键盘快速找回已回答的会话，或在会话间切换？
I want to browse installed skills and insert a slash command into my draft without replacing its text.
Shortcut Extensions 的功能「模型快速切换」：通过快捷操作打开可搜索的模型列表，支持键盘选择并切换当前会话的模型；用户还能置顶常用模型。
Shortcut Extensions 的功能「技能命令插入」：打开技能列表后可浏览已安装技能，并将选中的 /name 命令插入当前输入框光标处，保留草稿的其他内容。

A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds a keyboard-driven quick-switching layer to the DSH web/desktop UI: a model palette, a session palette with prompt preview, session cycling, find-next-answered, composer focus, and configurable permission cycling — all manageable from a sidebar control panel.

dsh-shortcut-extensions README · dsh-shortcut-extensions · 快捷键拓展：中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。
- **Header chips** — the current workspace name and git branch sit right beside the session title (`conversation.session.header.actions`); the branch is re-read whenever you enter a session.
- **Skill palette** (⌘⇧K) — lists installed skills from `skills/list` and inserts `/name ` at the caret without touching the rest of your draft.
- The workspace and git-branch chips use a stable per-name hue (colored tags).

dsh-shortcut-extensions README · Features：- **Model palette** (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+M`) — fuzzy search; AntD-style colored provider tags (click a tag to filter that provider); name-suffix tags (e.g. `routing group`); reasoning badges; pin favorites to the top.
- **Session palette** (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S`) — two-column layout: sessions on the left, your own prompts preview on the right (follows the highlighted row, debounced + cached). Includes archived sessions with badges; Enter opens and auto-restores archived ones.
- **Session cycling** (`Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab`, desktop) — cycle in the sidebar's recency order.
- **Find next answered session** (`Cmd/Ctrl+G`, web `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+G`) — jumps to the most recently answered not-yet-viewed session; falls back to sessions that are still running.
- **Focus composer** (`Cmd/Ctrl+I`) — restores caret position via the host composer facade.
- **Permission cycling** (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P`) — cycles through the presets you configure (any 2+ of Read Only / Workspace Write / Full access, plus any deployment-specific presets), expandable in the panel.

dsh-shortcut-extensions README · Default shortcuts (macOS desktop; Ctrl on Windows/Linux)：| Command | Keys |
|---|---|
| Model palette | ⌘⇧M |
| Session palette | ⌘⇧S |
| Permission cycle | ⌘⇧P |
| Find next answered session | ⌘G (web: ⌘⇧G) |
| Focus composer | ⌘I (web: ⌘⌥I) |
| Next / previous session | ⌃Tab / ⌃⇧Tab |

Every command can be rebound in **DSH Settings → Shortcuts** or in the panel's reference tab; overrides are device-local.

dsh-shortcut-extensions README · Install：1. Clone this repository.
2. In DSH, open **插件 (Plugins)** and install the plugin from the cloned directory.
3. Reload the window (Cmd+R).

Requires a standard DSH web composition. Optional host capabilities degrade gracefully: without permission presets the permission surfaces hide; without the turn-outline projection the prompt preview shows a notice.

dsh-shortcut-extensions README · Notes & limitations：- Browsers reserve some keys: single-modifier bindings like `Cmd+G` are desktop-only, and `Cmd+Shift+P` is taken by Firefox (private window).
- In the desktop app, `Cmd+W` belongs to the native "close window" menu item and cannot be taken over by plugins.
- Keybinding overrides are stored per device (desktop: `userData/keybindings.json`; web: origin-local storage).

dsh-shortcut-extensions README · Development：Plain JavaScript, no build step, no npm dependencies (React is provided by the host module table):

```

├── package.json        # manifest: bundle patch + dsh.client declaration

├── index.js            # host half (empty apply; all features use host services)
